summary.headline: Inox Wind Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR872 crores, adjusted EBITDA INR237 crores (~27% margin), PAT INR64 crores; FY27 guidance of 75% revenue growth reaffirmed.
summary.overview: Consolidated Q1 FY27 revenue was INR872 crores with adjusted EBITDA of INR237 crores, PBT of INR95 crores, PAT of INR64 crores and cash profit of INR153 crores. Management said the pivot toward equipment supply (about 59% of third-party order book as of July 2026) is disrupting near-term revenue, with benefits expected from Q2-end and mainly in H2. The order book is about 4.4 GW after a 200 MW NLC India LOA, and an MOU for 1.5 GW with INOX Clean (500 MW firm). Analysts pressed hard on the H2-weighted guidance, flat year-on-year Wind revenue and the pending INR400 crore deferred revenue, and management largely refused to quantify quarterly numbers.

financial_highlights.change: No year-on-year growth cited; management said Q1 is at par with Q1 FY26

financial_highlights.value: INR57.9 crores, of which INR50+ crores operational

segments.name: Inox Wind (WTG and EPC)
segments.commentary: Order book about 4.4 GW as of July 2026, with equipment supply about 59% and turnkey 41% for third-party orders. Management says equipment-supply margin and revenue benefits show from Q2-end, predominantly H2.

segments.name: INOX Green (O&M)
segments.commentary: Q1 total income INR101 crores, EBITDA INR57 crores, PAT INR41 crores; machine availability ~96.3%. Own portfolio ~13.3 GW peak (10.5 GW wind operating, rest solar), with ~6.5 GW acquired wind O&M assets still not consolidated. Management guides ~50% O&M EBITDA margin.

segments.name: INOX Renewable Solutions (IRSL / RESCO, EPC)
segments.commentary: Demerger of power evacuation infrastructure business from INOX Green completed; record date August 1, 2026, listing expected in about 2-3 months pending regulatory approvals. Transformer expansion (4.9 MVA, then 8-20 MVA and 100 MVA+), 4 cranes in operation, and USS launch planned in FY27.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue growth of about 75% over FY26 maintained; management reiterated it as an annual, not quarterly, target.
Consolidated EBITDA margin guidance of 20% to 22% for full year FY27 maintained.
H2 heavy: 70% to 75% of annual business expected in H2; H1 about 25% of annual operations.
INR600 crores annual EBITDA guidance for INOX Green maintained, expected on annualised basis from Q3 FY27 once Wind World India (acquisition expected to complete in Q2 FY27) is consolidated.
Deferred revenue of about INR400 crores from Q4 FY26 to be recognised partly in Q1, fully within FY27.
Working capital guidance on annualised basis maintained; receivable days expected to fall over the next 3-4 quarters.
capex_capacity: 4X wind turbine: foundation complete, tower and main components ready; first prototype installation targeted August 2026, commercial launch about a month later.
Management said it is contemplating higher turbine models (5X/6X) if market demand exists.
ALMM and indigenisation: 80-90% of wind turbine components already indigenised; target near 100% indigenisation before end of calendar 2026 for 3X and 4X.
Transformer capacity expansion in IRSL (Jaipur): 4.9 MVA next, then 8-20 MVA and 100 MVA+ units; own crane fleet of 4 with more in FY27; USS and inverters/capacitor systems planned.
INOX Clean plans 3 GW+ annual IPP capacity; management expects ~25-30% of that to flow to Wind and the balance to Green (O&M) and RESCO (EPC).
demand_pricing: Order book ~4.4 GW as of July 2026, visibility of 24-36 months; 200 MW repeat LOA from NLC India in July via tender.
MOU for 1.5 GW with INOX Clean in June 2026; firm orders for 500 MW so far, balance 1 GW to be firmed later.
Indian wind additions of 1.4 GW in Q1 FY27; total installed wind 57.4 GW; management expects 8-10 GW annual additions over next few years.
Blended realisation for INOX Green's ~4 GW consolidated wind portfolio of INR9-10 lakh per MW (excl. GST); acquired portfolios expected to be substantially higher.
Wind World India: ~4.5 GW O&M portfolio, FY26 revenue ~INR580 crores, ~5% contracted annual price escalation; clients include Tata, ReNew, Greenko, Apraava, Hindustan Zinc.
Management said there is no preferential pricing for INOX Clean versus third-party customers.

qa_highlights.question: What was MW execution in Q1 and what is the FY27 estimate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give MW numbers; it now guides on revenue and margin rather than machine volumes.

qa_highlights.question: Can revenue growth of 30% and 20% EBITDA margin be confirmed for next quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: No quarterly guidance; management reaffirmed 75% full-year growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin, with significant improvement expected in Q2 and H2 weighting.

qa_highlights.question: Why is revenue flat YoY and is the company no longer doing EPC?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed flat revenue to the pivot to equipment supply causing disruption; it said Q1 is at par with prior-year Q1 and that EPC continues within IRSL with ~40% of third-party orders turnkey plus 1.5 GW INOX Clean MOU and NLC LOA.

qa_highlights.question: Receivables are high versus peers; how are EPC receivables accounted?
qa_highlights.answer: Receivables are recognised under Ind AS 115 on risk-transfer basis and remain elevated until commissioning; management said receivable days fell in Q1 (figures not disclosed) and should drop substantially over the next 3-4 quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR600 crore Green EBITDA guidance annual or quarterly?
qa_highlights.answer: Annual basis, expected from Q3-Q4 FY27 post consolidation of acquisitions; management would not guide on FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Are INOX Clean terms arm's length versus other customers?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said contracts are arm's length, INOX Clean is treated as a customer, and there is no preferential pricing for it.

qa_highlights.question: Risks to meeting the 75% growth guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO cited only force majeure events; said the equipment-supply pivot carries no seen risk to deliverables.
